detail: Makefile line 3: PYTHON := $(shell if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then echo .venv/bin/python; else command -v python; fi). The fallback turns a missing-venv setup step into a missing-package error in an unrelated tool. Either fail with 'run python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e .[dev]', or add a make target that creates it. The setup is documented at docs/runbooks/project-working-practices.md:64 but nothing points there from the failure.

The contrast is the point: Playwright detects declared-vs-actual drift and prints the reconciling command, while the sprintctl extras, .venv and node_modules gaps all reported as missing packages in unrelated tools. Playwright is the shape a bootstrap reconciliation should copy. Note the browser cache is at ~/.cache, outside the repo, so it is per-host state that no repo checkout can carry -- exactly the workstation/devbox-vm/pod split AGENTS.md documents and nothing enforces.
